cards.text: Jacob, also called Israel (Genesis 35:10), has just blessed the two sons of his son Joseph (Genesis 48:20). Now he calls all his sons together and tells them to gather around and listen to their father. Friend, this is the kind of meeting where NOBODY is checking their phone.

cards.question: Jacob has all his sons gathered around him. What does he say he's going to tell them?

answers.text: What will happen to them in days to come
How his flocks will be divided among them
Why the whole family must leave Egypt

cards.question: Jacob starts with his firstborn son, the oldest of them all. That's ___.

cards.text: Jacob calls Reuben his might and the beginning of his strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power. That's a review I'd FRAME and hang over my oven.

cards.question: After all that praise, Jacob says Reuben will keep on excelling.

cards.text: Jacob says Reuben is uncontrolled as the waters, and he says why: “because you went up to your father’s bed, onto my couch, and defiled it.”
Next, Jacob takes two sons at once, Simeon and Levi, and says their swords are weapons of violence.

cards.question: Jacob says he never wants to join Simeon and Levi's assembly.

cards.text: Jacob says why: “For they kill men in their anger, and hamstring oxen on a whim.” Then he says, “Cursed be their anger, for it is strong, and their wrath, for it is cruel!”

cards.question: Jacob says he will keep Simeon and Levi together in Israel.
Now it's Judah's turn. What does Jacob say Judah's brothers will do?

answers.text: Praise him and bow down to him
Turn on him and drive him out
Forget him and leave him behind

cards.text: Jacob says Judah is a young lion, coming back from the prey. Then he says, “Like a lion he crouches and lies down; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him?”

cards.question: Jacob's lion picture makes Judah sound weak and easy to push around.

cards.text: Then Jacob says, “The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes…”

cards.question: Jacob says the scepter stays with Judah until Shiloh comes. What does he say about the nations?

cards.text: Then Jacob says Judah ties his donkey to the vine, his colt to the choicest branch.

cards.question: Judah's donkey is tied to the vine, and Jacob says Judah washes his garments in ___.

cards.text: Friend, my apron gets washed in plain old water, and this man is doing laundry in WINE. Then Jacob says Judah's eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.
Zebulun gets an OCEAN view: he'll live by the seashore and become a harbor for ships, with his border reaching to Sidon. Then Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.

cards.question: Issachar sees that his resting place is good and his land is pleasant. What does he do?

answers.text: He bends his shoulder to the burden
He lies down and refuses the work
He drives the other flocks away

cards.text: Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel. Then Jacob says Dan will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse's heels.

cards.question: When Dan the snake bites the horse's heels, the horse's rider stays in the saddle.
Right in the middle of blessing his sons, Jacob stops and speaks one short line to someone else. Who does he speak to?

cards.text: And here's what Jacob says: “I await Your salvation, O LORD.” Then, just like that, he's back to his sons.

cards.question: Jacob says raiders will attack Gad. What does Gad do?

cards.text: Asher's food will be rich, and he'll provide royal delicacies, and friend, I bake cookies for a LIVING and I'm still a little jealous. Then Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
Then comes Joseph, a fruitful vine by a spring, whose branches scale the wall. But it hasn't been easy for him: the archers attacked him with bitterness and aimed at him in hostility.

cards.question: When the archers aim at Joseph, Jacob says Joseph drops his bow and runs.
Jacob says Joseph's strong arms were tempered by someone's hands. Whose?

cards.text: Jacob says the God of Joseph's father helps him, and the Almighty blesses him with blessings of the heavens above and blessings of the depths below.

cards.question: In blessing Joseph, Jacob calls him the prince of his brothers.
Last comes Benjamin, a ravenous wolf. Jacob says that in the morning he ___ the prey.
When Jacob is done, he has given all twelve sons the exact same blessing.

cards.text: Then Jacob gives his sons one last instruction. He's about to be gathered to his people, and he tells them where to bury him.

cards.question: Jacob wants to be buried with his ___ in a cave in the land of ___.

cards.text: It's the cave in the field that Jacob's grandfather Abraham bought as a burial site. Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried there, and so are Jacob's father Isaac and his wife Rebekah.

cards.question: Jacob also buried one of his own wives in that cave. Which one?

cards.text: When Jacob finishes instructing his sons, he pulls his feet into the bed, breathes his last, and is gathered to his people. But stay close, friend, because this family's story isn't finished yet.
